newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close higher amid retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close higher amid retail buying.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed up amid retail buying of engineering, Pharmaceutical and cement scrips ahead of Moslem Friday weekend, brokers said.
The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) rose 16.58 points or 0.85 percent at 1,962.31 on a turnover of 100.4 million taka. Of 105 traded issues 62 gained and 40 lost.

"A number of textile and food scrips lost on profit taking, but most of the scrips gained amid fresh commitments," said one broker. National Tubes gained 162 taka to 1,784, Apex Foods shed 506 to 4,560 and Beximco Pharmaceuticals was up 8 to 202.
